text: The New Zealand Government Landslide Risk Financing Initiatives (2020–2025) is a cross-agency, system-wide set of instruments designed to manage landslide risks. It involves national regulatory and building guidance, land-use planning, risk assessment, public information, and insurance arrangements. The initiative aims to identify, reduce, price, transfer, and finance landslide risks, aligning with international risk governance principles and disaster risk reduction ethos.
